Hana: Heads-up — CopperBridge POC kickoff today. They need a 1-page connectivity checklist + mini runbook for PrivateDeploy. Requirements: connector in customer VPC, egress via their TLS SNI proxy, preserve client src IP, static egress allowlist. Can someone draft? cc @Luca @Priyanka
Luca: I can draft. Quick Q: will they accept interface endpoints (PrivateLink) for control plane, or do they mandate peering? Need both options documented.
Priyanka: They prefer PrivateLink but legal may force peering. Outline both with pros/cons.
Luca: Minimal firewall/egress snippet for their net team (outbound from connector hosts):
```
# outbound TLS to Redwood control & model endpoints
ALLOW tcp 443 to control.<region>.redwood-hosted.net and models.<region>.redwood-hosted.net
# DNS
ALLOW udp 53 to <customer-dns> or 8.8.8.8
# NTP
ALLOW udp 123 to pool.ntp.org
# If PrivateLink: allow interface endpoint ENI IPs (we provide list)
# If peering: allow egress to provided model IP ranges/ASNs
```
Priyanka: Callouts: preserve source IP (no SNAT before proxy), stable egress IPs (we can provide), and SNI passthrough required for TLS-inspect. If they must intercept TLS, recommend mTLS between connector and proxy or cert pinning.
Hana: Also they asked for an operator egress kill-switch and an auditable flow. Can you add options?
Luca: Two simple kill-switch patterns: (1) create a blackhole route for connector subnet (immediate stop), (2) update SG/NACL to drop outbound to model egress. Both actions logged via ops runbook and tied to oncall.
netops-bot: Smoke-test after allowlist applied:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood-hosted.net/healthz --resolve "api.redwood-hosted.net:443:<connector-ip>"
```
Priyanka: Ops runbook checks to include:
- curl health check from bastion with --resolve
- tcpdump on proxy to confirm original client IP
- openssl s_client -connect <proxy>:443 -servername api.redwood-hosted.net to validate SNI
- verify route table points connector subnet to proxy without NAT
Hana: Security bullets for questionnaire (short): TLS 1.2+ enforced (1.3 recommended); key mgmt: customer KMS (HSM) OR Redwood-managed with attestation; audit logs: export to S3/syslog, retention options 30/90/365d; operator controls: RBAC + MFA; kill-switch logged.
Luca: Pricing note: PrivateDeploy base + infra fee; static egress IPs or reserved GPU pools -> reserved-capacity add-on (12mo). I'll paste numbers in the external quote.
Priyanka: Drafting the 1-page checklist + 1-page ops runbook now, will paste in ~30m.
Hana: Thanks team :thumbsup:
